lines.en: I trudge past the wood's edge.
My leg plates hang with mud.
Each step flattens a patch of grass.
I walk around the dead tree.
My steps are heavy and slow.

lines.zh: 我把胸口那点浊气吐出来
lines.en: I vent the foul air in my chest.
I drift from the plain to the treeline.
My claws drag along the ground.

lines.zh: 我在锚点附近绕了一大圈
lines.en: I circle wide around my anchor.
I come slowly down the grassy slope.
I shift another stretch along.
I stop and face the trees.
I pace away from the anchor.

lines.zh: 我又迈着沉步往林里去
lines.en: I tramp deeper toward the wood.
I stand nailed at the treeline.
My chest heaves as I breathe.
Purple light crawls in my seams.
I let my claws hang at my knees.
My eyes are a dead glow.
I stay rigid a long while.
I swing my head to and fro.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在泥上拖出痕
lines.en: My tail scrapes a line in the mud.
I wait for someone to give an order.
My breath comes out sour.
I hold my jaws open and vent.
I stand facing the trees, unmoving.
I keep watch by my anchor.
I shake the mud off my head.

lines.zh: 我从上面低下头来看你
lines.en: I lower my head down at you.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛颜色有点不对劲
lines.en: My eye colour is a little wrong.
I slant my head to one side.
You smell too clean.
I do not much like that smell.

lines.zh: 我一脚踩到你前面半步
lines.en: I plant a foot half a step ahead.
My claws have started to work.
I am in no hurry to lunge.
I drop my head a little.
I watch both your hands.
Have you heard that sort of sound?
My breathing has deepened.
I part my jaws and close them.
You speak first.
I wait for your business.

lines.zh: 我的影子正落在你脚上
lines.en: My shadow lies on your feet.
My chest plate is dented in.
I shift a step backward.
I growl low in my throat.

lines.zh: 我低头看了看那道口子
lines.en: I look down at the split.
I settle my weight again.
My claws dig into the ground.
I did not make a sound.
That wound is no trouble.
I twist my upper body back.
Rust on my tongue, and I still stand.
That is the smell of raw meat.
I walk toward the smell.
I dip my head and sniff twice.
I tip my head and gulp it down.
The taste has turned sour.
I bite off another mouthful.
I would like a few more.
I look up at what you hold.
I lick between my teeth.
That meat is turning; I step back.
I sniff at the thing.
Two gulps and it is gone.
You charge; my feet hold fast.
I crowd you out with my pauldron.
You are shoved two steps out.
I look down at you.
Our plates crash and rattle.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上刮出声
lines.en: My claws screak on the ground.
I feel no pain at all.
I nail my feet back down.
That force will not shift me.
I turn my front back to you.

lines.zh: 另一头从林线那边过来
lines.en: Another comes along the treeline.
The two of us stand together.
Its armour is dirtier than mine.

lines.zh: 我们一同把眼睛转向林子
lines.en: We both turn our eyes to the trees.

lines.zh: 它从胸里吐出一口浊气
lines.en: It vents foul air from its chest.
I press my brow to its.
We both fall silent.
It heads into the trees first.
I take up its stride.
Our shadows overlap into one.
I bend down and grab it.
I hold it up to my snout.
One clench and I swallow.
I cough it back up.

lines.zh: 我一爪把东西钉在地上。
lines.en: One claw pins it to the ground.
I shake my head to throw off the dirt.
I kick it aside.
I stop looking at it.
I lower my head to search again.
I turn my back and go.
My head comes up.

lines.zh: 我把沉重的上身转过去
lines.en: I swing my heavy upper body over.
The crack in my chest glows.
I gather the stuff in my throat.
I have you in view.
I open both claws slowly.
This breath will carry acid.
I bear down your way.
My tail stiffens to a line.
The acid mist is at my lips.
I close my claw tips.
I am moving now.
I close in, stepping in your prints.
I press in inch by inch.
You cut left; I lean left.
The acid stays at my jaws.
I am in no hurry to breathe it.
You are behind a tree.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴把那棵灌木扫折
lines.en: My tail snaps the shrub aside.
I have read your pattern.
I circle to close from a new side.
You have glanced up.
This is just the range for the breath.
I lower my head and aim.
I chop a claw down.
My steel claw scores its armour.
I breathe out a cloud of acid.
The acid spreads around its feet.
I ram with my chest plate.
It slides several steps away.
I sink my teeth in its shoulder.
My tail cracks against its waist.
It stops my first claw.
I add one more claw.
It has begun to cough.
It withdraws; I do not chase far.
I step out at the wood's edge.

lines.zh: 腿甲上的泥还在往下掉
lines.en: Mud still drops from my leg plates.
My foot cracks the ground.
I take my stand here.
Steel toes sink into the wet soil.
A sour smell floats in the air.
I raise my head and look all around.
I recognise that anchor.
A red light flickers in my eye.
I begin to patrol this patch.

lines.zh: 我从胸腔里排出一口气
lines.en: I vent a breath from my chest.
I will hold here.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴压平了一片草。
lines.en: My tail flattens a patch of grass.
I straighten my body up.

lines.zh: 我胸口那门炮，已经上膛。
lines.en: The cannon in my chest is loaded.
I crash down from above.

lines.zh: 水才没到我的膝弯，我不怕。
lines.en: The water only reaches my knee; I am not afraid.

lines.zh: 爆风把我一侧肩甲掀开
lines.en: The blast peels one pauldron back.
Something lodges in my armour seam.
Spell light burns inside my joints.
Hunger keeps my claw down.
Lightning travels over all my plates.
There is nothing to stand on.
